name: Peak near Shackleton
reference: NASA PGDA product 78, https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/products/78. Barker, M. K., et al. (2021). Improved LOLA elevation maps for south pole landing sites: Error estimates and their impact on illumination conditions. Planetary and Space Science, 203, 105119. doi:10.1016/j.pss.2020.105119; tile Site07
notes: Catalogue south-pole-candidate-sites entry pgda78-site07 (PGDA Site07). NASA Artemis III candidate region (2022): Peak Near Shackleton. Reference point: Centre of the site's PGDA 5 m/pixel LDEM tile, converted from south polar stereographic (lat_0 = -90, lon_0 = 0, k = 1, sphere R = 1737400 m, MOON_ME/DE421) to planetocentric latitude and east longitude. It is the centre of the mapped region, NOT a selected landing point.

evidence.statement: Body-fixed Cartesian position of the site on the reference sphere.

sources.title: LOLA reference sphere radius (1737.4 km)
sources.citation: NASA PDS Geosciences Node, LRO LOLA Gridded Data Record (GDR) product labels; LRO Project and LGCWG (2008), 'A Standardized Lunar Coordinate System for the Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter and Lunar Datasets' (white paper).

assumptions: Height above the reference sphere not sampled; h = 0 m assumed.
Coordinates are the published catalogue reference point (planetocentric, MOON_ME); see the site's reference and notes.
